Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear notes and the annotated doc. Short answers up front:

- Measurement baseline: we measure billable units based on tokens emitted by the model after server-side deduplication (i.e., prefix caching that eliminates duplicate generation across requests). That is what feeds into billing and into the metrology used for floor/ceiling triggers.

- Reconciliation cadence: true-ups occur monthly on the billing period. Credits for overage above the ceiling are applied in the following invoice; adjustments below the floor trigger a pro-rated invoice correction the same month. We can add explicit language with examples to Exhibit E.

I'll loop in Karthik and Laura for legal precision and to propose amendment language. We're generally comfortable with your 2026-11-01 target if we can land a short annex describing the measurement signal and the monthly true-up workflow.

Hannah — following Markus's note, please find below proposed contract language we intend to insert as an Annex to Exhibit E. I'm sending the plain text here for quick review; tracked-change version attached in Exhibit-E_fee-matrix_annotated.docx.

PROPOSED ANNEX (plain language):
1) Metrology Definition: For purposes of this Agreement, "Metrology" shall mean the measurement of Customer usage for billing and reconciliation purposes as recorded by Redwood's serving telemetry. Redwood will measure Billable Units as the number of model output tokens generated for Customer requests after server-side deduplication and prefix caching optimizations. Billable Units exclude internal test traffic as identified by API key tags and requests flagged by Customer via the usage-reporting webhook within 5 business days.

2) Ceiling/Floor Reconciliation: Reconciliation of Commit Floors and Dynamic Ceilings shall occur on a monthly basis. For each billing period, Redwood will compute the total Billable Units. If total Billable Units exceed the Ceiling for the period, overage will be invoiced and applied as a credit adjustment against the next invoice. If total Billable Units fall below the Floor, Redwood will issue a pro-rated credit or charge according to the Fee Matrix in Exhibit E. Examples: (a) A one-time spike that breaches Ceiling in month M will be invoiced in M+1; (b) sustained usage below Floor for a full invoice quarter triggers a one-time reconciliation adjustment at quarter close.

3) Caching and Prefix Exclusions: Prefix caching that results in zero token emission for repeated requests shall not be double-counted; however, partial cache hits that still emit tokens are billable. Redwood will provide a monthly metrology report with token-level breakdowns and cache-hit rates upon Customer request (standard CSV export).

Please confirm whether these points are acceptable or if Vertex needs the Annex to reference a different measurement window (e.g., 95th percentile over trailing 30 days) or an alternate true-up cadence. If you approve, we'll prepare a redline for signature and circulate a DocuSign envelope.

Regards,
